title: SPEC A implementation: config staging/live promotion

completion_criteria.text: The seven unit PRs are all on main: five merged into stack parents rather than main and were re-integrated bottom-up through two further pr.mjs PRs, verified by merge-base ancestry.
The three release-rejecting defects are fixed and the validator hardened through two reviews, including a CRITICAL code-execution path in the python checker, shipped as merged PR #54.
SPEC A section 7's five cutover preconditions are all closed and verified, with the *session* gitignore pattern narrowed BEFORE the hook file it hides is adopted.
The promote verb is implemented with pre-swap validation, rollback by rename, and the LIVE receipt, and the bootstrap resolves outside releases/.
The stale ccstatusline declaration that would have downgraded live on every promote is fixed and merged as PR #61, caught by diffing the rehearsal's reconciled settings against the live file.
SessionStart and Stop converge hooks are registered, and a drift report reaches session context when live differs from main.
The settings.json ownership manifest and the separate capture verb are implemented, with unknown keys defaulting to LIVE WINS and flagged rather than dropped.
The cutover unit is hardened until an independent review returns SHIP; two rounds returned BLOCK and the third was restated at the property level after a containment check proved unsound.
The cutover runs serially in a session doing nothing else: the first release is built and validated with zero live change, then every entry link is swapped in one pass.
All 10 of SPEC A's acceptance criteria pass, with criterion 10 verified by diffing the live tree against the release rather than asserted.
Every unit ships through a PR opened by pr.mjs pr-create, stacked with --base <parent-branch> where one change blocks another.

spine.active_goal: Run the c5 entry-link cutover so live skills and hooks resolve through the release, then verify SPEC A's 10 acceptance criteria.
spine.next_step: START HERE IN A FRESH SESSION, doing nothing else. spine.last_session: Ran the faithful rehearsal (zero failures), fixed the ccstatusline downgrade as merged PR #61, then completed the live bootstrap reinstall and the first live promote at 75b90a3.

open_risks.text: Give every sub-agent dispatch run_in_background false — three orchestration attempts were lost because parent agents ended their turns while believing they were blocking on background children
Never run git checkout main in the primary checkout — live global config is symlinked into that working tree, so switching branches hot-swaps every skill and hook under every running session
Serialize every write to a live-linked path, not just the cutover — a half-saved file reaches running sessions through the hook symlinks and breaks every one of them instantly
Treat the round-6 open-questions artifact as superseded rather than as instructions — it names a constant that exists nowhere and reads as licence to amend the permit-set in prose, which 0305 forbids

Confirm the five notes files were copied into local/notes and byte-verified before the link is repointed — two hold the confidential material 0276 refused to publish, and the sources are deliberately left in the checkout for a human to remove

Expect the swap to change live content rather than merely a level of indirection — live config resolves into the primary checkout on feat/invariant-inert-registry today, while the release is built from main

The live settings.json is not restored by a cutover rollback — rollback authority covers only the entries the verb links, so any settings.json edit made during or after the swap has no tool-supported undo
Observe the converge drift report actually firing before treating c3 as proven — registration and a clean exit 0 on both events are verified, but no run has yet produced a real drift report
Recover from this release with the settings backup and by removing the current symlink, not with rollback — the first LIVE receipt records previous as null, so rollback has no target at all

key_decisions.title: SPEC A is implemented and shipped by a dedicated small dynamic workflow, with stacked PRs for blocking changes
The workflow fan-out boundary is any write to a live-linked path, not the cutover alone
Three plans are scrubbed at source; notes/ is reclassified live-only and never enters a release
chore/config-drift is the stack root and the inert basis lands before SPEC A's units
The inert basis ships as one atomic change carrying its evaluator, never as registry data alone
The inert basis leaves this phase's critical path; it buys SPEC A's PRs nothing and is under an open BLOCK
Every cutover attempt rehearses the real promote verb against a scratch config root before any live write
Release validation fails closed on any registered hook it cannot verify
Three residual validator weaknesses are disclosed in the invariant record rather than fixed
A test that spawns a real interpreter is either availability-guarded or converted to assert checker selection
The bootstrap installs as a pinned copy of an import-derived closure, not a symlink or a hardcoded file list
The entry-link swap ships as a tested cutover verb, bundled with the guard fix and the grant correction, before any live write
settings.json stays a real live file and the guard's probe test is what changes
The stale ln -sfn grant is withdrawn by promotion, not merely refused by capture
One fresh session builds the cutover unit and then performs the live cutover as its last act
The cutover verb moves real content aside instead of deleting it, which defers the graphify-report ruling rather than forcing it
Promotion applies the reconciled settings.json to live, because the withdrawal set 0288 adopted is inert without it
The live swap moves to a dedicated session, honoring SPEC section 7 substance over 0289 session count
Containment is split by write kind, because link writes do not follow the final path component and content writes do
A hook's output channel follows its exit code rather than its event, because only the success path was being discarded
An invariant is a quantifier over a closed code constant with a permit-set and an executable witness; anything else is a rule and leaves the contract
A closed vocabulary enters the census only if we own the code and production branches on the value, and an exclusion downgrades rather than deletes
A permit-set is a materialized falsifier fixture and never prose, because only a fact stored twice can drift
The invariant checks split by determinism: the diff-independent check always gates, the diff-dependent one runs only on pull requests
Step 0 lands only the workflow properties main can carry, and gates the whole invariant-coverage job
The receipt's restated scope flags are disclosed as a threatened M2 rather than fixed in the same unit
The Q4 deletion lane removes whole registry entries only, and writes the live tree directly under a single serialized writer
A coverage receipt is removed once its change merges, because a registry designed to grow cannot keep re-validating history
The homegrown invariant system is retired whole and the receipts plugin becomes the only owner of invariant checking
This repo deploys a receipts gate to itself rather than relying on the template it hands to other repos
A commit stranded on a merged stack parent is re-landed from its own branch, so ancestry stays an identity proof
The swap is operated by a dedicated fresh-context agent, honoring 0292's hazard rather than its session count
Round 6 exits on a green witness plus a green meta-witness, not on a review returning SHIP
The two production guard sets stay separate; GUARDED_CONFIG_ENTRIES is not implemented
The aside name carries its release identity, resolving the cross-release case rather than a residual
The cutover unit is finished from its branch; its one real defect sits on an axis a rebuild would reproduce
A check the approved order schedules after the PR is disclosed in the body, never reordered to earn a verified line
The LIVE receipt records the primary checkout as repo_root, never a disposable worktree
A repo-owned version pin must track the live value, or promotion silently downgrades it

out_of_scope: Building SPEC B Part IV's stacked-PR machinery to serve this work
Editing mitosis.js or the parallel engine, which SPEC B governs
Updating the Claude Code plugins through the release mechanism — enabledPlugins, pluginConfigs and extraKnownMarketplaces are live-owned, so promotion never carries them
